biggest_catch: No annual fee, so the math is clean: up to $200 cash back for $2,000 of planned spending in six months is a straight ~$200 net — as long as the $2,000 was spending you were doing anyway. Your offer may be less than the $200 max.
catches: Only claim this bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend $2,000 in six months — never spend extra to chase a bonus.
There is no annual fee on this card, so the fee doesn't eat the bonus — the net is the full cash-back amount you qualify for.
The offer is 'as high as' $200 — Amex tells you your exact amount during the application and it may be lower.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry.
Once-per-lifetime rule: no welcome offer if you have or have had the Blue Cash Everyday, Cash Magnet, Blue Cash Preferred, Morgan Stanley Blue Cash Preferred, or previous versions.
Amex's eligibility check can deny the welcome offer based on your history (cards opened/closed, balance-transfer history); you are notified before processing so you can withdraw.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay in full.

Fees, interest, balance transfers, cash advances, gift cards, prepaid reloads, and person-to-person payments do not count toward the $2,000 threshold; account must not be past due or cancelled when the Reward Dollars post.

steps: Apply for the Blue Cash Everyday Card on the official Amex page — not from an affiliate link with different terms.
During the application Amex tells you the exact cash-back amount you qualify for (as high as $200); withdraw if you are shown no offer.
If approved, make $2,000 in eligible purchases you were already planning within the first 6 months of Card Membership.
Pay the balance in full every month.
Keep the account open, not past due; the Reward Dollars post 8-12 weeks after you hit $2,000.
Redeem the Reward Dollars as a statement credit (or at Amazon.com checkout).
timing: Reward Dollars are applied 8-12 weeks after you meet the $2,000 spend threshold.
